paper.title: Contextual Bandits with Online Neural Regression

settings.name_in_paper: Neural Contextual Bandits (NeuCB) with adversarial contexts
unmapped: Each arm has a context vector x_{t,a} in R^d with ||x_{t,a}|| <= 1; E[y_{t,a}|x_{t,a}] = h(x_{t,a}) for an unknown function h (losses, minimised)
NTK matrix on all contexts at initialization is positive definite with min eigenvalue lambda_0; the learner uses lambda_0 to set the projection radius rho = Theta(sqrt(T)/lambda_0)
settings.definition_quote: At any round $t \in [T]$, the learner observes the context for $K$ arms $\x_{t,1}, ,...,\x_{t,K} \in \bbR^d$, where the contexts can be chosen adversarially. The learner chooses an arm  $a_t \in[K]$ and then the associated output $y_{t, a_t} \in [0,1]$ is observed. ... $\E[y_{t,a} |\x_{t,a}] = h(\x_{t,a})$.

settings.out_of_scope_reason: Online regression (full-information prediction with a neural network), not a bandit problem; used as a subroutine for the bandit reduction.
unmapped: Learner predicts real outputs with parameters theta in a comparator ball B, observes true outcome y_t in [0,1]; regret against best theta in B on the loss ell
settings.definition_quote: At round $t \in [T]$, the learner is presented with an input $\x_{t}  \in \cX \subset \bbr^d$ and is required to make real-valued predictions $\hat{y}_{t}$. Then, the true outcome $y_{t} \in \cY = [0, 1]$ is revealed.

algorithms.name: Projected Online Gradient Descent (on perturbed network)

conditions: Assumption 5: NTK at initialization positive definite with min eigenvalue lambda_0 > 0
holds with high probability over the random initialization and perturbation vectors

source.label: thm:NeuSquareCB_main_regret
source.quote: Under Assumption~\ref{asmp:realizability_bandit} and \ref{asmp:ntk} with appropriate choice of the parameter $\gamma$, step-size sequence $\{\eta_t\}$ width $m$, and regularization parameter $c_p$, with high probability over the randomness in the initialization and $\{\epsvec\}_{s=1}^S$ the regret for $\mathtt{NeuSquareCB}$ with $\rho = \Theta(\sqrt{T}/\lambda_0), \rho_1 = \Theta(1)$ is given by ${\reg(T)} \leq \tilde{\cO}(\sqrt{KT})$.

results.notes: Regret is E[sum y_{t,a_t} - y_{t,a_t^*}] with per-round best action a_t^* = argmin h(x_{t,a}); treated as pseudo-regret vs per-round best. Bound on expected regret holds with high probability over network initialization/perturbation. Via SquareCB reduction plus O(log T) online regression regret.

conditions: Assumption 5: NTK at initialization positive definite with min eigenvalue lambda_0 > 0
holds with high probability over the random initialization and perturbation vectors

source.label: thm:NeuFastCB_main_regret
source.quote: Under Assumption~\ref{asmp:realizability_bandit} and \ref{asmp:ntk} with appropriate choice of the parameter $\gamma$, step-size sequence $\{\eta_t\}$ width $m$, and regularization parameter $c_p$, with high probability over the randomness in the initialization and $\{\epsvec\}_{s=1}^S$, the regret for $\mathtt{NeuFastCB}$ with $\rho = \Theta(\sqrt{T}/\lambda_0), \rho_1 = \Theta(1)$ is given by $\reg(T) \leq \tilde{\cO}(\sqrt{L^*K}+K),$ where $L^* = \sum_{t=1}^{T} y_{t,a_t^*}$.

results.notes: First-order bound; gamma tuned using L*. Theorem 3.3 KL-loss online regression assumes y_t in [z,1-z]. Via FastCB reduction.

symbols.lambda_lip: Lipschitz constant of the loss w.r.t. the prediction
symbols.L_interp: inf over theta in B of cumulative loss sum_t ell(y_t, g(theta; x_t))

conditions: Assumption 2: loss is epsilon-almost convex, satisfies QG with constant mu, has a unique minimum
Assumption 3: loss Lipschitz (lambda), strongly convex (a), smooth (b) in the prediction

source.label: thm:PLregret
source.quote: Under Assumptions~\ref{asmp:qg_thm_asmp} and \ref{asmp:smooth} the regret of projected OGD with step size $\eta_t = \frac{4}{\mu t}$, where $\mu$ is the QG constant from Assumption~\ref{asmp:QG-thm-B}, satisfies $\tilde{\Rl}(T)\leq \cO\left( \frac{\lambda^2}{\mu}\log T\right) + \epsilon T + 2 \underset{\theta \in B}{\inf}\sum_{t=1}^T\lossonlineg{\theta}.$

results.notes: Deterministic online regression regret (no expectation); O applies to the first term only. Out-of-scope (non-bandit) setting.

conditions: Assumption 5 NTK positive definite with lambda_0
probability at least 1 - C/T^4 over initialization and perturbations
tuning: appropriate step sizes, width m, perturbation constant c_p

source.label: thm:hp_reg_sq_loss_online
source.quote: Under Assumption \ref{asmp:real},\;\ref{asmp:init} and \ref{asmp:ntk} with appropriate choice of step-size sequence $\{\eta_t\}$, width $m$, and perturbation constant $c_{p}$ ..., with probability at least $\big(1 - \frac{C}{T^4}\big)$ ... the regret in $\cref{eq:reg_sq}$ of projected OGD ... is given by $\Rsqt(T) = \cO(\log T).$

source.quote: Under Assumption \ref{asmp:real},\;\ref{asmp:init} and \ref{asmp:ntk} for $y_t \in [z , 1-z]$, $0<z<1$, with appropriate choice of step-size sequence ..., with high probability ..., the regret of projected OGD with loss $\cL_{\kl}^{(S)}$ ... is given by $\Rkl(T) = \cO(\log T)$.
